name: auriga-workflow
description: The auriga workflow skill bundle: incremental-impl (implementation slicing), test-designer (independent test design), spec-design (requirement clarification), arch-design (architecture design), code-simplify (code simplification), session-compound (session compounding), goalify (autonomous /goal planning), deep-review (multi-dimensional PR review orchestrator), and reviewer-creator (custom reviewer scaffolding). Dual-Agent compatible (Claude Code + Codex).

interface.longDescription: Bundles every auriga-owned workflow skill in one plugin: incremental-impl for implementation slicing, test-designer for independent test design, spec-design for requirement clarification, arch-design for architecture design, code-simplify for code simplification, session-compound for session compounding, goalify for planning and dispatching an autonomous /goal, deep-review as a multi-dimensional PR review orchestrator, and reviewer-creator for scaffolding project-level custom reviewers.
defaultPrompt: Use the auriga workflow skills when the workflow calls for them.
